title: Lostz Earth Lite Zombie Apocalypse
description: A lightweight zombie survival modpack with unique apocalypse mods, realistic weapons, and PUBG-style gameplay focused on performance.
body: Why use this modpack? Because this modpack is completely different from all the others. It gives Minecraft a zombie survival experience with essential apocalypse mods and hidden gems like Survivor Arsenal, adding realistic weapons, tactical looting, and immersive survival gameplay. The modpack is also lightweight and focused on performance for smoother gameplay, and I’ll try my best to keep adding more mods that are unique for a zombie modpack.
